sources.title: Visit Turks and Caicos Islands, Turks and Caicos Official Public Holidays: 2026
sources.said: New Year’s Day 1 January Thursday; Commonwealth Day 9 March Monday; Good Friday 3 April; Easter Monday 6 April; JAGS McCartney Day 25 May Monday; King’s Birthday 15 June Monday; Emancipation Day 3 August Monday; Constitution Day 31 August Monday; National Youth Day 25 September Friday; National Heritage Day 12 October Monday; Christmas Day 25 December Friday; Boxing Day (Observed) 28 December Monday. When these holidays fall on a weekend, they are observed on the following Monday. Government offices are closed on public holidays.

sources.title: Visit Turks and Caicos Islands, Turks and Caicos Public Holidays: New Holiday Added, Thanksgiving Now in August (23 December 2025)
sources.said: The Turks and Caicos Government has announced several changes to the country's public holiday schedule for 2026 ... Thanksgiving ... will now take place in August on the Sunday before Constitution Day rather than in November ... Constitution Day will become an official public holiday in 2026, when it will be observed on August 31 ... and will take place annually on the last Monday in August.
